lines.vo: Why does checking off one tiny task feel so good?
That's not silly. That's the progress principle.
Jay breaks his big goal into small steps in his Daily Habit Builder.
Researchers studied nearly twelve thousand daily diary entries from two hundred thirty eight workers.
lines.cap: Researchers studied nearly 12,000 daily diary entries from 238 workers.

lines.vo: On their best days, the most common trigger was simply making progress, even small progress.
Each small win seems to feed motivation, and motivation makes the next step easier.
So shrink the step until you can win today.
Small win, check the box, repeat. That's how you stay on track.

hook: Why ticking *one box* feels this good
